_about.experiment: sweep_blocks, condition F: oracle-simulator practice with sparse external evaluation. NOT RUN YET (prepared 2026-11-27).
_about.root: a root of its own, forked (xsim/fork_root.py) from the snapshot of out/xsim/sweep_blocks/rep0: the same initial program A
_about.development: F starts from the same initial program as B, C and D (no practice world: it practises in the target simulator). $80 after initialization; 300 practice episodes in the target simulator, scene checks counted, judged by its own self-check (the official judge is not asked and not shown); separately at most 5 submissions x the same first 5 scenes of the frozen development panel, judged by the official evaluator, as for B, C and D.
_about.oracle_reference: F receives up to 300 + 25 = 325 target-simulator interactions. It is an oracle reference, not a target-interaction-matched comparison.
